helper.stream_uptime: How long the stream has been live
helper.stream_is_live: Whether the stream is currently live
helper.stream_started_at: The timestamp the stream went live
helper.tts_audioconnected: Whether an Audio widget page is open for the channel, so TTS can be heard (true or false)
helper.status: The stream live status (live or offline)
helper.provider: The platform that delivered the event (e.g. twitch or kick)
helper.ad_when: When the next ad starts (e.g. "in ~3 minutes")
helper.ad_seconds: The length of the coming ad break in seconds (e.g. "90")
helper.ad_automatic: Whether the ad break was automatic ("true") or requester-triggered ("false")
helper.poll_status: How the poll ended (completed, terminated or archived)
helper.poll_winner_votes: The number of votes the winning choice got
helper.poll_winner_percentage: The winning share as text, like (68%), or nothing when no one voted
helper.poll_results: Every choice with its votes and share, separated by {'|'}
helper.message: The message attached to the event (a Twitch resub or cheer message)
helper.also_said: "They also said: ..." - the Twitch resub message, pre-formatted with a lead-in and quotes; empty when the resubscriber didn't write one
helper.event_count: How many were gifted (Twitch gift subscriptions)
helper.anonymous: Whether the sender chose to stay anonymous ("true"/"false")
helper.gifter: Who gifted the Twitch sub to this viewer ("Anonymous" when the gifter stayed anonymous)
helper.gifter_id: The gifter's platform user id; empty when the gifter stayed anonymous
helper.viewers: The viewer count carried over by a raid
helper.input: The viewer's text input on the redemption, if any
helper.moderator: The moderator's display name (falls back to their ID)
helper.reason: The moderation action's reason, if one was given
helper.event_duration: "permanent" for a ban, a length like "10 minutes" for a timeout, or the finished stream's length
helper.broadcaster: The broadcaster display name (stream.online/.offline and the Discord go-live seed alias)
helper.title: The stream title (stream.online and the Discord seed alias)
helper.game: The stream game/category (stream.online and the Discord seed alias)
helper.engagement_days_since_last_seen: Days since this viewer was last seen chatting
helper.engagement_months: How many months this moderator has moderated the channel
helper.engagement_years: The same anniversary in years, rounded for reading aloud
helper.supporter_kind: The kind of supporter event (tip, membership, merch, charity)
helper.supporter_amount: The supporter amount, in major currency units (e.g. "12.34")
helper.supporter_tier: The supporter's membership tier, if any
helper.supporter_quantity: How many of the item the supporter gave, if applicable
helper.supporter_message: The message the supporter attached, if any
helper.obs_event_field: A field from the OBS event's own payload (e.g. {'{'}obs.event.sceneName{'}'})
helper.vts_event_field: A field from the VTube Studio event's own payload (e.g. {'{'}vts.event.modelName{'}'})
helper.random_user: A random chatter currently in the channel
helper.random_number: A random whole number from 1 up to N (e.g. {'{'}random.number.100{'}'})
helper.random_number_range: A random whole number between a minimum and a maximum, with an optional step (e.g. {'{'}random.number.50.990.10{'}'})
helper.roll: A named random roll, drawn once per message: name, minimum, maximum and an optional step (e.g. {'{'}roll.pct.60.98{'}'})
helper.roll_read: The value of a named roll again, so one roll can show in many places (e.g. {'{'}roll.pct{'}'})
helper.roll_complement: 100 minus a named roll, for two percentages that add up to 100 (e.g. {'{'}roll.pct.complement{'}'})
helper.random_pick: A random pick from a dot-separated list (e.g. {'{'}random.pick.a.b.c{'}'})
helper.list_pick: A random entry from a named pick-list (e.g. {'{'}list.pick.jokes{'}'})
helper.custom_data: A field from an ingested custom data source (e.g. {'{'}custom.mysource.field{'}'})
helper.transform: Applies a text transform (upper/lower/title/reverse/etc.) to the wrapped text
helper.args_all: Everything typed after the command, as one text
helper.args: Command argument N (e.g. {'{'}args.1{'}'} is the first word after the command)
helper.user_provider: The platform the triggering user connected from (e.g. twitch)
helper.user_account_age: How long ago the triggering user account was created
helper.user_follow_age: How long the triggering user has followed the channel
helper.user_message_count: The triggering user total chat message count
helper.user_lastmessage: The triggering user most recent chat message
helper.user_link: A profile link for the triggering user
helper.viewer_messages: The triggering user total chat message count
helper.viewer_watchtime: The triggering user total watch time
helper.viewer_firstseen: When the triggering user was first seen in chat
helper.viewer_redemptions: The triggering user total channel point redemption count
helper.viewer_songrequests: The triggering user total song request count
helper.viewer_commands: The triggering user total commands used
helper.viewer_days: The triggering user whole days since first seen (at least 1 once seen)
helper.viewer_avgperday: The triggering user average chat messages per day since first seen
helper.viewer_botpercent: The triggering user share of chat messages that were commands, as a whole percent
helper.viewer_data: A per-viewer data field for the triggering user (e.g. {'{'}viewer.data.key{'}'})
helper.target_displayname: The {'@'}mention target's stored display name, or the typed text when the user is unknown
helper.target_known: Whether the {'@'}mention target matches a user the bot knows (true or false)
helper.target_follow_age: How long the {'@'}mention target has followed the channel
helper.target_lastmessage: The {'@'}mention target most recent chat message
helper.target_lastmessage_full: The {'@'}mention target most recent chat message, never cut short
helper.target_randommessage: A random older chat message of the {'@'}mention target, fit to quote
helper.target_link: A profile link for the {'@'}mention target
helper.target_messages: The {'@'}mention target total chat message count
helper.target_firstseen: When the {'@'}mention target was first seen in chat
helper.target_redemptions: The {'@'}mention target total channel point redemption count
helper.target_songrequests: The {'@'}mention target total song request count
helper.target_days: The {'@'}mention target whole days since first seen (at least 1 once seen)
helper.target_avgperday: The {'@'}mention target average chat messages per day since first seen
helper.target_botpercent: The {'@'}mention target share of chat messages that were commands, as a whole percent
helper.target_data: A per-viewer data field for the {'@'}mention target (e.g. {'{'}target.data.key{'}'})
helper.name: The name shown - the {'@'}mention target if present, otherwise the triggering user
helper.link: A profile link - the {'@'}mention target if present, otherwise the triggering user
helper.subject: The subject-case pronoun (e.g. they)
helper.gendered_term: A gendered term matching the person pronouns (e.g. guy/gal)
helper.user_subject: The subject-case pronoun for the triggering user
helper.user_object: The object-case pronoun for the triggering user
helper.user_possessive: The possessive pronoun for the triggering user
helper.user_present_tense: The present-tense to-be form for the triggering user
helper.user_gendered_term: A gendered term for the triggering user
helper.user_tense: The live/offline-aware tense for the triggering user
helper.target_subject: The subject-case pronoun for the {'@'}mention target
helper.target_object: The object-case pronoun for the {'@'}mention target
helper.target_possessive: The possessive pronoun for the {'@'}mention target
helper.target_present_tense: The present-tense to-be form for the {'@'}mention target
helper.target_gendered_term: A gendered term for the {'@'}mention target
helper.target_tense: The live/offline-aware tense for the {'@'}mention target
helper.verb: A singular/plural verb agreeing with the mirrored subject (e.g. {'{'}verb:plays{'|'}play{'}'})
helper.user_verb: A singular/plural verb agreeing with the triggering user (e.g. {'{'}user.verb:plays{'|'}play{'}'})
helper.target_verb: A singular/plural verb agreeing with the {'@'}mention target (e.g. {'{'}target.verb:plays{'|'}play{'}'})
helper.channel_name: The channel display name (Discord seed alias)
helper.channel_title: The stream current title (Discord seed alias)
helper.channel_game: The stream current game/category (Discord seed alias)
helper.raw_message: The raw triggering chat message (Discord pipeline seed alias)
helper.playlist_id: The id of the playlist the track was added to
helper.track_name: The name of the track that was added
helper.music_favorite_track: The name of the viewer's most-requested track
helper.music_favorite_artist: The artist of the viewer's most-requested track
helper.music_favorite_count: How many times the viewer has requested that track
helper.music_favorite_outcome: What happened: queued, none, or unavailable

attention.attention_integration_expired_message: Its access has expired. Reconnect it to restore the integration.
attention.attention_integration_refresh_failed_mes: Refreshing it failed {failureCount} times in a row. Reconnect it to restore the integration.
attention.attention_integration_unusable_message: The saved sign-in can no longer be used. Reconnect it to restore the integration.
attention.attention_integration_decrypt_failed_mes: The saved sign-in can't be decrypted any more, so the bot can't use it. Reconnect it to restore the integration.
attention.attention_held_title_one: A chat message is held for review
attention.attention_held_title_many: {count} chat messages are held for review
attention.attention_unmanaged_rewards_title_one: 1 channel-point reward is not managed by the bot
attention.attention_unmanaged_rewards_title_many: {count} channel-point rewards are not managed by the bot
attention.attention_unmanaged_rewards_message: They were made elsewhere, so you cannot edit them here. Take control of them on the Rewards page.
attention.attention_unmanaged_rewards_pending_mess: They were made elsewhere. {pendingCount} of them wait for you to free up their title on Twitch.
attention.attention_scope_missing_topics_message: Twitch refused these event feeds: {topics}. Grant the permission to get them back.
attention.attention_scope_missing_message: A bot feature cannot work without this permission. Grant it on the Integrations page.
attention.attention_eventsub_unauthorized_message: Twitch no longer accepts your sign-in for: {topics}. Reconnect Twitch to get them back.
attention.attention_widget_build_failed_message: Version {version} did not build. Your stream still shows the last working version.
attention.attention_widget_build_failed_nothing_li: Version {version} did not build, so this widget shows nothing on stream.
attention.attention_security_impersonation_started: A NomNomzBot operator is acting as {targetName}
{operatorName} opened a support session on your channel. Reason: {reason}
attention.attention_security_impersonation_ended_t: A NomNomzBot operator stopped acting as {targetName}
attention.attention_security_impersonation_ended_m: {operatorName} closed the support session. Reason given: {reason}
attention.attention_security_access_granted_title: A NomNomzBot operator opened support access to your channel
attention.attention_security_access_granted_messag: {operatorName} opened the access. It ends on its own when the support session expires.
attention.attention_webhook_disabled_message: It failed {failureCount} times in a row. Fix the receiver, then turn the webhook on again.
attention.attention_webhook_failing_message: The last {failureCount} deliveries failed. Check the receiver.
attention.attention_song_lost_message: “{trackName}” for {requestedBy} left the player queue before it played. Any cost was refunded.
attention.attention_song_lost_unnamed_message: A request left the player queue before it played. Any cost was refunded.
attention.attention_heat_timeout_failed_message: Their heat passed your limit, but Twitch refused the timeout: {error}. Nobody acted, so check their chat and act by hand.
attention.attention_automod_delete_failed_title: AutoMod could not delete a message
attention.attention_automod_delete_failed_message: The rule “{ruleName}” tried to delete a message from {userName}, but Twitch refused. The message stays in chat. Make sure the bot is a moderator in your channel. Failed deletions in the last day: {count}.
attention.attention_shared_ban_title: A shared ban was not applied
attention.attention_shared_ban_origin_not_trusted_: {targetName} was banned in a channel you do not trust, so your channel did not copy the ban. Add that channel to your trusted peers if you want its bans. Bans skipped in the last day: {count}.
attention.attention_shared_ban_no_shared_session_m: {targetName} was banned in a channel that is not in your shared chat, so your channel did not copy the ban. Shared bans only work while both channels are in the same shared chat. Bans skipped in the last day: {count}.
attention.attention_shared_ban_twitch_ban_failed_m: Twitch refused the ban for {targetName}: {detail}. They are not banned in your channel, so ban them by hand if needed. Make sure the bot is a moderator. Failed bans in the last day: {count}.
attention.attention_shared_ban_twitch_ban_failed_n: Twitch refused the ban for {targetName}. They are not banned in your channel, so ban them by hand if needed. Make sure the bot is a moderator. Failed bans in the last day: {count}.
attention.attention_mass_ban_failed_title: The mass ban in {channelLogin} did not finish
attention.attention_mass_ban_failed_message: {failedCount} of {totalCount} accounts could not be banned in {channelLogin}. The others were banned. Twitch may have been busy or refused them, so retry them from Moderation. Make sure the bot is a moderator in your channel.
attention.attention_filter_action_failed_title: The {filter} filter could not act on {username}
attention.attention_filter_action_failed_message: The {filter} filter tried to act on {username} ({action}), but it failed: {reason}. Nobody stopped them, so check the chat and act by hand. Make sure the bot is a moderator in your channel.
attention.attention_owner_action_failed_message: A widget or script ran this action for you, and it did not work: {error}. Check that the target is connected, then try it again.
attention.attention_bot_not_moderator_title: {botName} is not a moderator in your channel
attention.attention_bot_not_moderator_message: Type /mod {botName} in your Twitch chat. Twitch limits what a bot without the moderator role can do.
attention.attention_spotify_blocked_message: Spotify blocked your Spotify app after too many requests. Song requests and now playing wait until then. To continue now, make a new app in the Spotify Developer Dashboard and enter its Client ID and Client Secret on the Integrations page.
attention.attention_audio_source_missing_message: Add the Audio widget as a browser source in OBS. Until then, sounds and TTS play from another overlay page.
attention.attention_audio_source_missing_live_mess: TTS has nowhere to play. Add the TTS source in OBS.
attention.attention_source_unavailable_message: This check failed, so some items may be missing here. Reason: {reason}. To fix it, reconnect Twitch on the Integrations page.

labels.shortcutsHint: Ctrl+P files · F1 commands · Ctrl+S save
labels.unsavedChangesBody: You have edits that are not saved. If you close now, they are lost.
labels.sandboxHint: Runs what is in the editor right now, with sample events. Nothing is published and your live channel is never touched.
labels.historyHint: Every saved version, newest first. Publish any past version to make it the served one again; the current live version cannot be deleted.
labels.bundleHint: Bundle metadata for publishing this project.
labels.sdkTypesNotice: SDK types could not load. Type checking is off until you reopen this file.
labels.newFilePath: New file path, for example lib/helper.ts
labels.runNoteSandbox: This project runs in the bot sandbox, so there is nothing to render. Save & Compile validates it.
labels.runNoteRender: Renders the current editor contents. Fire an event below to drive it.
labels.previewScriptNote: Code scripts run in the bot sandbox. Press Save & Compile to validate.
labels.previewFireNoEvents: This widget listens to no events yet. Add nnz.on('follow', …) to your code and the event shows up here.
labels.eventSampleInvalid: Save stopped: the data of {types} is not a JSON object. Fix it or reset it to default.
labels.previewFireSamplesError: The test events could not be loaded, so nothing can be fired. Close the editor and open it again.
labels.previewUnavailable: Live preview unavailable (it could not load):
labels.previewUnavailableHint: Save & Compile still builds on the server.
labels.previewErrorBuildTitle: The preview could not be built
labels.previewErrorRunTitle: The widget stopped with an error
labels.previewSdkHttp: The preview SDK could not be fetched (HTTP {status}).
